name: Temporal Coherence Map
algorithm: Temporal Coherence Map — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method creates temporal coherence maps for deepfake detection:

1. **Feature跟踪AcrossFrames**: Dense feature correspondences are established between consecutive frames using optical flow, and long-range correspondences across multiple frames using feature matching. This creates a spatio-temporal feature trajectory map.

2. **局部相干性计算**: For each pixel, temporal coherence is computed as the consistency of its feature trajectory — smooth, physically plausible trajectories have high coherence, while erratic or discontinuous trajectories have low coherence. The coherence map reveals regions with temporal instability.

3. **相干性Map空间分析**: Natural video shows uniformly high coherence for static regions and physically motivated coherence patterns for moving objects. The method analyzes the coherence map for anomalous low-coherence regions — deepfake-generated areas often show reduced temporal coherence, particularly at face boundaries and in texture regions.

4. **人脸-Background相干性比较**: The average coherence in face regions vs. background provides a diagnostic ratio. In authentic video, both show similar coherence levels. Deepfakes typically show lower coherence in the generated face (per-frame independent generation) compared to the naturally captured background.

5. **相干性时间Trends**: The per-frame average coherence is tracked over time. Natural video maintains high, stable coherence. Deepfake videos may show coherence drops correlated with challenging face poses, expressions, or lighting conditions where the generator produces more temporally inconsistent output.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through temporal coherence map analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Amerini, I. et al. (2019). Deepfake Video Detection through Optical Flow based CNN. ICCV Workshop.
